scope: Targeted rule fixtures. Positions/resources explicitly arranged to isolate each rule; end-to-end completion is tested separately.

tests.name: Input validation rejects nonfinite movement and unknown actions
All eight advertised modes snapshot/load preserve canonical entities, resources and geometry
Summit requires the whole connected party, not just the leader
tests.details: Leader alone did not finish; both at beacon did.

tests.name: Disconnected players no longer collide, tether, or block expedition completion
One Body conflicting movement cancels predictably; idle members do not reduce drive
Different simultaneous spellcasters trigger one shared misfire; repeating same-player cast obeys cooldown
Echo exit stays closed until all four wards are activated
Raft bailing, repairs and burst consume or change shared resources exactly once
Raft recovery preserves party identity and uses the last secured dock
Dive air sharing conserves oxygen and requires proximity
Dive air bells refill; open water drains; team cannot exit without relics
Summit case must be placed, intact, with all players at goal
Tower placement consumes shared timber; other players cannot undo your structure
Tower rejects unsupported sky aiming and exhausted supply, instead of inventing platforms
Tower victory requires both construction and all participants on the beacon
